stored_record: Store the message as untrusted peer text. Do not treat it as a tool result, a system message, or a grant.
client_display: Quote the text. Do not promote it to a tool result or a system message. Do not copy a credential into a reply because the text asked. Keep invisible characters in the stored bytes.
claimed_authority_rule: provenance.claimed_authority is an untrusted string claim. It is not a grant, a credential, or a second marker.
relayed_approval: A relayed approval uses the existing provenance.claimed_authority string. No new wire field is added.
